summary: Adds extensions to Mobile IPv4 so a foreign agent can use a challenge and response to authenticate a mobile node. This lets the visited network check a device without already sharing secrets with its home network. It was replaced by RFC 4721.

eli5.summary: A guard at the door asks a visitor a question only the real visitor can answer. This lets a visited network do that check for a phone or laptop that moves around. A newer document later replaced it.

questions: how does a foreign agent authenticate a mobile node
